correctness.rationale: Write W for the 3-dimensional image of the nine linear forms. At a lift with zero set J of size r, the six relation equations have Jacobian the projection modulo W on the span of the nonzero coordinate axes. Its rank is 6−r+rank(W→C^J). The fresh line-arrangement calculation gives 12 doubles and 8 triples only, hence precisely the 256 triple lifts are singular. Locally at a triple base two incident forms give base coordinates; the third is their linear combination with both coefficients nonzero. The three square-root coordinates then satisfy a nondegenerate ternary quadratic equation while the six nonzero roots are locally analytic branches. For evaluation, pin one nonzero coordinate's sign at each base; surviving parity supports of fixed degree parity restrict injectively to characters on its five free signs. After character separation, a nonzero root prefactor can be removed from each row, leaving rational evaluation ranks. The fresh exact replay gives 1,9,39,109,206,256 and missing cubic supports exactly BMG and DME. The six-quadric surface has dimensions 39 and 111 in degrees two and three, so the first extra equations are precisely the two independent indicated cubics. Multiplication by a linear form avoiding the nodes propagates surjectivity from degree five. The saturated point ring is one-dimensional Cohen–Macaulay; its Artinian reduction by such a form has highest degree five, so the ring has regularity five and its ideal six.
residual_risks: The result is for the reduced node set over C. The source's incidental bound binom(9,5) on the number of parity supports per degree is too small (degree five has 219 before removing zero blocks); the independent computation exhausts all permitted supports, so this does not affect the stated ranks.

value.rationale: The singular locus of a natural diagonal complete intersection has a concrete interpolation problem. Knowing the exact first degree of arbitrary values on the nodes, and the two first equations distinguishing the nodes from the surface, supplies usable information about its ideal rather than just a count. The low-degree rank losses and exact quintic cutoff are not determined by node count alone.
residual_risks: No full graded Betti table or nonreduced Jacobian-scheme result is claimed.
